en.headline: Hong Kong Alliance and two former leaders found guilty of inciting subversion
en.dek: A High Court panel sitting at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts convicted the disbanded group, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung; Albert Ho earlier pleaded guilty and all face sentencing later.

zh.headline: 支聯會及兩名前領導被裁定煽動顛覆國家政權罪成
zh.dek: 高等法院三名國安法指定法官裁定已解散的支聯會、前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤罪名成立；何俊仁早前認罪，各人稍後判刑。

en.headline: After Taste exhibition opens in Cheung Sha Wan tracing a century of Hong Kong dining
en.dek: Local studio artellex and private collectors present rare menus, calligraphic scrolls and antique cookbooks from 21 August to 27 September, by appointment only.

zh.headline: 《過去味來》長沙灣開展 重現香港百年飲食演變
zh.dek: 本地工作室artellex聯同私人收藏家展出珍稀餐牌、書法字頭及古籍食譜，8月21日至9月27日舉行，需預約參觀。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued overnight, cancelled at 5:45 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 12:30 a.m. for isolated squally thunderstorms and cancelled it after dawn as the weather stabilised.

zh.headline: 天文台昨晚發出雷暴警告 今早5時45分取消
zh.dek: 天文台凌晨12時30分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至早上6時30分，預料局部地區有狂風雷暴，清晨5時45分取消。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific to launch direct flights to Almaty from January 2027
en.dek: The three-times-weekly service will be the airline’s first Central Asian destination and the only non-stop link between Hong Kong and Kazakhstan, subject to regulatory approval.

zh.headline: 國泰明年1月開通阿拉木圖直航 成中亞首個航點
zh.dek: 每周三班服務將成為國泰首個中亞目的地，亦是香港與哈薩克之間唯一直航客運航線，尚待當局批准。

en.headline: Customs seize three live cats at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line, arrest woman
en.dek: A 68-year-old mainland passenger was intercepted in the arrival hall with the animals in her luggage; the cats are valued at about HK$36,000 and the case has been referred to the AFCD.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢3隻懷疑非法進口活貓 拘68歲女
zh.dek: 關員在入境大堂截查一名抵港內地女旅客，於行李內發現3隻活貓，估計市值約3.6萬元，案件交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Woman found dead in Ta Kwu Ling with suspected animal bite marks
en.dek: Police are investigating after a 33-year-old woman was discovered collapsed outside a village house near a dog training centre and boarding facility on Thursday afternoon.

zh.headline: 打鼓嶺女子伏屍村屋外 身上疑有動物咬噬痕跡
zh.dek: 一名33歲女子周四下午在坪洋新村坪原路一村屋外被發現倒臥，當場證實死亡，屍體有懷疑動物咬噬痕跡，警方正調查。

en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after toddler suffers second-degree burns in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 30-year-old Indonesian woman was detained on suspicion of ill-treating or neglecting a child in her care; the 23-month-old girl remains in hospital under observation.

zh.headline: 元朗女童手部二級燒傷 30歲印傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 23個月大女童雙手燙傷送院觀察，印尼籍家庭傭工涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略，明日提堂。

en.headline: HAECO and CALC sign MOU to develop aircraft engine maintenance centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The partnership will focus initially on quick-turn services, hospital repairs and engine asset management, according to the Transport and Logistics Bureau.

zh.headline: 港機工程與中國飛機租賃簽備忘錄 擬設引擎快修中心
zh.dek: 合作初期聚焦快修、大修及引擎資產管理，運輸及物流局指有助鞏固航空樞紐地位。

en.headline: July consumer prices rise 1.7% year on year as inflation stays moderate
en.dek: The smaller increase from June mainly reflected a rates concession; underlying inflation held at 1.9% after stripping out one-off relief measures.

zh.headline: 7月綜合消費物價指數按年升1.7% 基本通脹維持1.9%
zh.dek: 升幅較6月放緩主因差餉寬免，剔除政府一次性措施後基本通脹率與上月相同。

en.headline: Unemployment rate holds steady at 3.7% for May–July period
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted jobless rate remained unchanged while the underemployment rate edged up to 1.7%; total employment rose by about 1,500 people.

zh.headline: 5至7月失業率維持3.7% 就業不足率微升至1.7%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率與上期相同，總就業人數增加約1,500人，失業人數增加約6,000人。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued until 8:30 pm as isolated storms affect Hong Kong
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 7:05 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the territory before cancelling it later in the evening.

zh.headline: 天文台傍晚發出雷暴警告至晚上8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台下午7時05分發出雷暴警告，預料香港有局部地區雷暴，有效時間至晚上8時30分。

en.headline: Customs arrest two over HK$35 million money-laundering linked to earlier drug case
en.dek: Financial investigation of a 2025 narcotics seizure uncovered suspicious transfers of about HK$35 million through the personal bank accounts of two 33-year-old local men between January 2024 and August 2025.

zh.headline: 海關跟進毒品案拘兩男 涉清洗黑錢約3500萬元
zh.dek: 根據2025年一宗毒品案財富調查，兩名33歲本地男子個人銀行戶口於2024年1月至2025年8月有大量可疑交易，涉款約3500萬元，昨被控處理犯罪得益。

en.headline: Police smash three drug stores in Kwai Chung and Tsuen Wan, arrest four including three…
en.dek: Officers seized ketamine, crack cocaine and other drugs worth more than HK$1.4 million; a 19-year-old is alleged to have recruited the three minors for storage, packaging and delivery work during the summer holiday.

zh.headline: 警搗葵涌荃灣三毒品倉拘4人 包括3名未成年少年
zh.dek: 檢獲氯胺酮、霹靂可卡因等市值逾140萬元毒品；19歲男子疑招攬3名16至17歲少年管倉、包裝及派送，每人報酬數百元，案件明日西九龍法院提堂。

en.headline: Transport Department to use AI for faster licence renewals and smart traffic lights
en.dek: Online vehicle licence renewals and cross-boundary permit applications are targeted for automated approval by year-end; a Causeway Bay junction will trial real-time pedestrian-priority signals from early 2027.

zh.headline: 運輸署推AI加快續牌及智慧燈號 銅鑼灣路口明年試行
zh.dek: 年底起用大型語言模型自動審批網上續領車牌及跨境駕駛計劃申請，目標九成自動批核、最長審批時間由10個工作天縮至1天；銅鑼灣告士打道路口明年首季試行實時燈號，行人最長等候可減15至20秒。

en.headline: Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival opens Friday at HKCEC
en.dek: The four-day technology fair runs 21–24 August under the theme ‘AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future’, with an AI and digital transformation zone and more than 20 free workshops.

zh.headline: 香港電腦通訊節周五會展開鑼 主題「AI Connect」
zh.dek: 展覽8月21至24日於灣仔會展1號展覽廳舉行，設AI及數碼轉型專區，並有逾20場免費AI講座及工作坊。

en.headline: Yuen Long large-dog owner charged over fatal attacks appears in court, granted bail
en.dek: A 52-year-old man faces two counts of allowing a large dog to enter a public place without a secure leash; the case was adjourned to 29 October and he was released on HK$3,000 cash bail.

zh.headline: 元朗大狗咬斃兩犬案 狗主提堂准3千元保釋
zh.dek: 52歲男狗主被控兩項容受大型狗隻在公眾地方未穩妥牽引罪，屯門裁判法院押後至10月29日再訊，被告准以3,000元現金保釋。

en.headline: Police drone operation leads to drug arrest after minivan intercepted on Route 3
en.dek: Officers from New Territories South stopped a seven-seater near Ching Lai Court after spotting unstable driving and an irregular number plate; cannabis and sildenafil tablets were found inside.

zh.headline: 警無人機執法截七人車 檢大麻及「偉哥」拘男司機
zh.dek: 新界南交通特遣隊今早在三號幹線及龍翔道一帶用無人機執法，於清麗苑附近截停一輛行駛不穩及車牌不合規格的七人車，車內檢獲懷疑大麻及壯陽藥。

en.headline: Man attacked and robbed of HK$300,000 Rolex in Sheung Shui
en.dek: Five men armed with iron bars set upon a 36-year-old victim near Hak Pai Tsai Village late on Wednesday; the attackers fled in a private car and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 上水男子遇襲被搶30萬元勞力士錶 五賊在逃
zh.dek: 36歲事主周三晚在沙頭角公路龍躍頭段黑排仔村遭五名男子持鐵通襲擊，勞力士錶被掠走，事主手部受傷及腰痛送院。

en.headline: Three arrested over Mong Kok One Piece card shop scam involving HK$1.47 m
en.dek: Police say 44 victims paid for game cards at a Nathan Road shop that suddenly closed; two local men and a foreign woman were detained on Tuesday on suspicion of obtaining property by deception.

zh.headline: 旺角海賊王卡牌店涉走數 44人損失147萬元拘三人
zh.dek: 警方指受害人向彌敦道一間遊戲卡店訂貨付款後店舖突結業，兩名本地男子及一名外籍女子周二被捕，涉嫌以欺騙手段取得財產。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued until 10:30 am as squally storms approach
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8:40 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory after areas of intense showers edged closer from the south and east.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告至上午10時30分
zh.dek: 天文台上午8時40分發出雷暴警告，預料香港有局部地區出現狂風雷暴，早前特別天氣提示指南部及東部海域強雨區正逐漸靠近。

en.headline: Kwai Chung Hospital opens city’s first dedicated psychiatric block for under-18s
en.dek: The redeveloped main and child-and-adolescent blocks provide 1,000 beds and a ‘therapeutic village’ design; most services have already moved, with remaining relocation due by September.

zh.headline: 葵涌醫院新大樓啟用 設全港首個精神科兒童青少年服務座
zh.dek: 重建後主座及兒童青少年服務座提供1,000張病床，引入治療村概念；絕大部分服務已遷入，餘下預計9月完成。

en.headline: JUPAS: 287 of 453 applicants succeed in reconsideration after DSE review
en.dek: Sixty-three per cent of those who sought a fresh look after rechecking results received an offer or a higher-preference programme; 83 students who had none previously gained a place.

zh.headline: 聯招覆核後重新考慮結果公布 287人成功佔六成三
zh.dek: 453名申請人中287人獲取錄或較高次序課程，成功率63.4%；83人由原先未獲派學位變為獲取錄。

en.headline: Local ice-cream brand TeemTonefai opens first permanent shop in Sheung Wan
en.dek: The 10-year-old maker of Chinese-ingredient flavours begins soft opening on 21 August at Upper Lascar Row, after years of pop-ups and collaborations.

zh.headline: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai上環開首間實體店
zh.dek: 成立十年的創意雪糕品牌8月21日起於上環摩羅上街試業，主打中式茶香及香料口味，過往以期間限定店及聯乘聞名。

en.headline: Tram derails in Central after Citybus swerves to avoid child, no injuries
en.dek: A Citybus route 930 vehicle struck a tram on Des Voeux Road Central near Jubilee Street on Wednesday evening while avoiding a five-year-old girl who had stepped into the roadway; services later resumed.

zh.headline: 中環城巴閃避女童撞電車出軌 無人受傷
zh.dek: 周三晚一輛930線城巴在德輔道中近租庇利街為避一名突然衝出馬路的5歲女童而撞向電車，導致電車出軌，車上無人受傷，電車服務其後恢復。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under continued easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory maintained the signal into Thursday morning, warning of strong easterly winds with occasional gale-force gusts and rough seas while monitoring a low-pressure area near Hainan.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風持續
zh.dek: 天文台周四清晨維持強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並繼續監察南海北部低壓區動向。

en.headline: Ocean Park’s Reptile Territory opens to public on Friday with nearly 20 species
en.dek: The new Summit pavilion features endangered rhinoceros iguanas, Chinese crocodile lizards and blue-tongued skinks, some rescued by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海洋公園爬行探索基地周五起對公眾開放 展出近20種爬行動物
zh.dek: 高峰樂園新展館包括國家一級保護瑤山鱷蜥、瀕危犀牛鬣蜥及藍舌石龍子等，部分動物來自漁護署充公後由園方護理。

en.headline: Government issues practice note for bonus plot ratio pilot scheme starting 1 September
en.dek: Developers redeveloping qualifying old residential buildings in seven designated districts can obtain an extra 20 per cent plot ratio free of land premium for five years.

zh.headline: 額外地積比率先導計劃9月生效 聯合作業備考詳列安排
zh.dek: 發展商在七個指定舊區拆卸樓齡50年或以上、地盤不少於700平方米的住宅樓宇並重建作住宅用途，可獲額外20%免補地價總樓面面積，計劃為期五年。

en.headline: MTR begins autonomous vehicle road tests linking West Kowloon and Kowloon stations
en.dek: Four Baidu Apollo sixth-generation cars started non-passenger trials on Wednesday along a designated route; a transfer service is targeted for the second quarter of 2027.

zh.headline: 港鐵西九龍展開自動車路面測試 目標明年第二季提供接駁服務
zh.dek: 四輛百度Apollo第六代自動私家車周三起在指定路段測試，初期不載客，後備操作員全程隨車；擬明年第二季推出高鐵與機場快綫接駁服務。

en.headline: Customs smash cannabis oil lab and distribution centre, seize HK$1.3 m drugs
en.dek: A 46-year-old Indonesian man was arrested in Prince Edward and charged with manufacturing and trafficking dangerous drugs after raids on industrial units in Kowloon Bay and Yau Tong.

zh.headline: 海關搗破大麻油製毒工場及分銷中心 檢130萬元毒品拘一男
zh.dek: 46歲持行街紙印尼籍男子在太子被捕，九龍灣及油塘工廈單位檢獲約1.9公斤懷疑大麻油、2.4公斤軟糖及2,200支煙彈，明日提堂。

en.headline: Cine Fan Summer International Film Festival opens with Na Hong-jin’s HOPE
en.dek: The Hong Kong International Film Festival Society’s summer programme runs until 31 August, opening with the South Korean director’s Cannes competition title and featuring a masterclass.

zh.headline: 夏日國際電影節開幕 羅泓軫《HOPE：逆襲希望港》打頭陣
zh.dek: 香港國際電影節協會主辦的夏日影展即日至8月31日舉行，開幕電影為康城主競賽作品，導演將來港主持大師班。

en.headline: Qatar Airways Cargo opens Hong Kong regional office and signs MOU with Airport Authority
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the move reflected confidence in Hong Kong as an international aviation hub and hinted at a forthcoming Central Asia passenger route.

zh.headline: 卡塔爾航空貨運設香港區域辦事處 與機管局簽備忘錄
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示此舉反映對香港作為國際航空樞紐的信心，並透露本地航空公司將公布中亞新航線。

en.headline: Chris Tang and Shenzhen officials inspect new Huanggang Port preparations
en.dek: The Security Bureau chief said both sides agreed the port could open once systems are fully equipped and cross-boundary stress tests are completed successfully.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強與深圳官員視察新皇崗口岸準備工作
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示雙方同意在檢測設施完善及跨境壓力測試順利完成後，可盡早啟用新口岸。

en.headline: Customs arrest two Opatra London managers over alleged aggressive sales
en.dek: A man and a woman described as financial and administration managers were detained on Wednesday after six complaints of high-pressure tactics involving sums of up to HK$100,000.

zh.headline: 海關拘Opatra London兩名經理 涉不良營商手法
zh.dek: 海關周三拘捕一男一女管理人員，涉使用具威嚇性的營業行為，接獲至少六宗投訴，涉款由1,800元至10萬元不等。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under continued easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory kept the signal active through the evening, warning of strong easterly winds, occasional gale-force gusts and rough seas, while monitoring a low-pressure area near Hainan.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風及大浪持續
zh.dek: 天文台周三晚維持強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並密切監察南海北部低壓區動向。

en.headline: Hong Kong Cyclothon returns 11 October with new five-tunnel three-bridge route
en.dek: Registration for the 56 km and 32 km public rides opens on 20 August; the event will again feature a UCI 1.1 road race and a family carnival at West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 香港單車節10月11日舉行 推「五隧三橋」路線
zh.dek: 56公里組及32公里組公眾騎行項目8月20日起接受網上報名，起點及終點設於西九文化區，並再次上演國際單車聯盟1.1級公路賽。

en.headline: Police lead 2,600-person drill for November Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: The overnight exercise at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, Victoria Harbour and West Kowloon tested crowd management, transport coordination and response to a simulated terrorist attack.

zh.headline: 警聯同多部門演練 為11月底國際刑警大會作準備
zh.dek: 逾2600人參與的跨部門演習於會展、維港及西九一帶進行，模擬人流管理、交通協調及恐襲應變，警務處處長周一鳴到場視察。

en.headline: Underground cable sparks and smoke force response on Pei Ho Street
en.dek: Firefighters attended reports of smoke and several loud bangs from manhole covers near vegetable stalls in Sham Shui Po on Wednesday morning; no one was injured and nearby shops temporarily lost power.

zh.headline: 深水埗北河街渠蓋冒煙傳爆炸聲 疑地底電纜肇事
zh.dek: 周三早上約10時半，深水埗北河街菜檔附近渠蓋冒煙並傳出多次巨響，消防射水降溫，無人受傷，附近部分商舖一度停電。

en.headline: Customs seize 200 live birds worth HK$20,000 at Lo Wu, arrest two
en.dek: A mainland woman and a local man were stopped at the arrival hall on Tuesday with bird cages in their luggage; the cases have been handed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖檢200隻走私活雀鳥值2萬 兩男女被捕
zh.dek: 海關人員周二在羅湖管制站入境大堂截查一名33歲內地女旅客及一名51歲本地男旅客，在行李內發現裝有雀鳥的鳥籠，兩人被捕，案件交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under hot and windy conditions
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reported temperatures around 31–33°C at noon with very high UV levels; strong easterly winds continue and the public is advised to beware of rough seas.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 天氣炎熱吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台中午錄得約31至33度，紫外線指數極高；偏東強風持續，市民須提防海面大浪。

en.headline: HKEX posts record first-half profit of HK$10.57 billion
en.dek: Second-quarter net profit rose 21 per cent to HK$5.38 billion, beating estimates, as average daily turnover hit a quarterly high and IPO fundraising nearly doubled.

zh.headline: 港交所上半年盈利創新高達105.7億元
zh.dek: 第二季純利升21%至53.8億元，勝過預期；日均成交創季度新高，IPO集資額近乎倍增。

en.headline: AFCD may euthanise large dog that killed two pets if owner surrenders it
en.dek: Assistant director Jackie Yip said the 60 kg mixed-breed dog remains under observation; if kept by the owner it could be declared a known dangerous dog requiring a muzzle and short leash.

zh.headline: 漁護署：元朗咬斃兩犬大狗若交由政府或考慮人道處理
zh.dek: 助理署長葉恩明表示，約60公斤混種犬仍在觀察中；若狗主繼續飼養，署方或申請將其列為已知危險狗隻，須戴口罩及用短於1.5米狗繩。

en.headline: Government aims to complete heat-stress warning system review by end of August
en.dek: Labour and welfare chief Chris Sun said the Labour Department and Observatory are working to adjust thresholds after the lowest-level alert stayed in force during record temperatures.

zh.headline: 政府料本月底前完成酷熱工作警告機制檢討
zh.dek: 勞福局局長孫玉菡表示，勞工處與天文台正就啟動門檻及觸發機制進行準備工作，以盡快落實優化。

en.headline: 75-year-old dies five days after To Kwa Wan minibus collision
en.dek: Wong was struck on 13 August at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Maidstone Road by a private minibus belonging to a social-service centre; the driver remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣75歲翁捱復康小巴撞 留醫五日後不治
zh.dek: 事主8月13日於落山道與美善同道交界被基督教家庭服務中心私家小巴撞倒，頭部受傷昏迷，延至18日下午不治；52歲司機早前涉危駕被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival set for 29 October to 1 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the annual event will return to the Central Harbourfront Event Space with more than 300 booths, new country pavilions and a month of citywide culinary follow-up activities.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮定於10月29日至11月1日舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局宣布年度盛事重臨中環海濱活動空間，設逾300個攤位、新增多個國家展館，並有「只在香港」風味活動及全城美食跟進推廣。

en.headline: Body of missing 64-year-old woman found in Yuen Long manhole
en.dek: Police discovered the body of Yeung during a missing-person inquiry on Tai Tong Shan Road on Tuesday afternoon; she had last been seen at her Kiu Hing Road home on 7 August.

zh.headline: 元朗失蹤64歲女子遺體於大棠山道沙井發現
zh.dek: 警方周二下午調查失蹤人口案時，在大棠山道一個沙井內發現楊姓女子遺體，事主8月7日最後於僑興路住所露面。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force as easterly winds continue
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reported sustained winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east overnight, with gusts reaching gale force at exposed locations including Waglan Island and Tap Mun.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風持續
zh.dek: 天文台指通宵吹偏東強風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，離岸及高地陣風間中達烈風程度，橫瀾島及塔門等地錄得較高風速。

en.headline: CFS urges public not to eat French spread product over possible Listeria contamination
en.dek: A batch of L'atelier Blini Ktipiti Extra Red Pepper & Feta Cheese Spread imported by City Super is being recalled after French authorities flagged a suspected cold-chain problem.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食法國進口塗抹醬 或受李斯特菌污染
zh.dek: 一批由City Super進口的L'atelier Blini Ktipiti特製紅椒菲達芝士醬因法國當局指懷疑冷鏈問題或受李斯特菌污染，正回收。

en.headline: AFCD arrests owner of large dog that killed two small pets in Yuen Long
en.dek: The 60 kg dog had been detained in July over a previous attack and returned after a warning; the department is investigating both cases and may prosecute.

zh.headline: 漁護署拘捕元朗咬斃兩小狗大狗飼主
zh.dek: 涉事約60公斤大狗曾於7月因另一咬傷案被扣留後發還，署方正調查兩案，如證據足夠將檢控。

en.headline: 16-year-old girl critically ill with influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The patient with chronic illness developed fever on 15 August and was transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit at United Christian Hospital; CHP says flu activity remains high.

zh.headline: 16歲少女感染甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 有長期病患少女8月15日起發燒，今日氣促送院，轉聯合醫院兒童深切治療部；衞生防護中心指流感活躍程度仍高。

en.headline: CHP investigates measles case involving 35-year-old woman, 198 contacts
en.dek: The non-locally born patient developed fever and cough from 4 August and a rash on 9 August; she is in stable condition and 198 close contacts are under medical surveillance.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查35歲女子麻疹個案 198人列密切接觸者
zh.dek: 患者非本港出生，8月4日起發燒咳嗽，9日出現皮疹，情況穩定；198名密切接觸者暫無病徵，正接受醫學監察。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal issued as easterly winds strengthen
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Thunderstorm Warning at 10:30 pm and issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 10:10 pm, warning of strong easterly winds and rough seas.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號生效 吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台晚上10時10分發出強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並於10時30分取消雷暴警告。

en.headline: Mainland hotpot ingredients chain Guoquan opens first Hong Kong store in Wan Chai
en.dek: The Hennessy Road outlet is described by the company as a ‘test bed’ for overseas expansion, offering community-kitchen style products adapted for local tastes.

zh.headline: 內地火鍋食材店鍋圈食匯灣仔開首店
zh.dek: 軒尼詩道門店被集團定位為海外布局「試驗田」，延續社區央廚模式並加入本地化產品。

en.headline: ICAC charges eight over MOS Burger ‘ghost worker’ payroll fraud
en.dek: A former store manager, his wife and six alleged ghost employees face conspiracy-to-defraud charges involving about HK$680,000 in wages and MPF contributions.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴摩斯漢堡前店長等8人涉「鬼工」騙薪68萬
zh.dek: 前店長、其妻及六名被指虛報出勤的店務員被控串謀詐騙，涉薪金及強積金合共約74萬元，案件轉介區院。

en.headline: Customs seize 240 kg of cannabis worth HK$56 m, arrest 10 in airport operation
en.dek: Month-long ‘Fire Mesh’ action targeted a syndicate using Hong Kong as a transit hub to move cannabis buds from Southeast Asia to Europe and Africa.

zh.headline: 海關「火網」行動檢240公斤大麻市值5600萬 拘10人
zh.dek: 為期一個月行動針對以香港為中轉站、由東南亞運大麻往歐洲及非洲的集團，於機場過境行李發現可疑包裹。

en.headline: Hong Kong mid-year population rises 0.3% to 7.52 million
en.dek: Net inflow of nearly 40,000 residents more than offset a natural decrease of 20,400, though births fell below 30,000 for the first time on record.

zh.headline: 年中人口增0.3%至751.8萬 出生人數首跌破3萬
zh.dek: 淨移入近4萬人抵銷自然減少2.04萬人，惟出生人數按年跌15.6%至2.97萬，創有紀錄新低。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 11 pm as squally storms continue
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory first issued the warning at 7 pm and later extended it, expecting a few more squally thunderstorms over the territory this evening.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至晚上11時 預料仍有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台傍晚7時發出雷暴警告，其後將有效時間延長至今晚11時，預料香港仍有幾陣狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Maxim’s Palace opens seventh branch at MOKO in Mong Kok
en.dek: The new outlet retains traditional hand-pushed dim sum carts and adds live roast suckling pig carving and a dim sum academy for customers.

zh.headline: 美心皇宮第七間分店進駐旺角MOKO
zh.dek: 新店保留人手推車點心傳統，新增現場燒乳豬切件及點心學堂體驗。

en.headline: Construction worker jailed 22 years for raping daughter over decade
en.dek: A High Court judge described the 14 rapes and one anal offence as leaving the victim living in hell and said the defendant’s remorse appeared only superficial.

zh.headline: 地盤工強姦親女十年判囚22年 官指事主如活在地獄
zh.dek: 高等法院法官指14次強姦及一項肛交罪令女兒十年如活在地獄，被告悔意流於表面。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court fire independent committee report delayed to end of October
en.dek: The Chief Executive has approved an extension so the panel can analyse more than one million files and complete its findings and recommendations.

zh.headline: 宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告延至十月底提交
zh.dek: 行政長官已同意延期，委員會指需時分析逾百萬個檔案及各方資料後才完成研判及建議。

en.headline: Postman dies after falling from Ming Wah Mansion in Shau Kei Wan
en.dek: A 57-year-old Hongkong Post employee was found unconscious outside the building around 8:30 a.m. and later pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital; the cause remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 筲箕灣明華大廈郵差墮樓送院不治
zh.dek: 57歲香港郵政員工今早約8時半被發現倒臥明華大廈外昏迷，送東區醫院後證實不治，死因有待調查。
